result.title: A Time-Synchronous Prequential Evaluation Framework for Next-Week Student Disengagement Prediction from Moodle LMS Logs
result.comment: Accepted for publication in the proceedings of SACAIR 2026 (Springer CCIS)
result.summary: Retrospective evaluation of early-warning models may not reflect information available when predictions are issued and outcomes become observable. We developed a time-synchronous prequential framework for online prediction of next-week student disengagement, operationalised as inactivity onset, from Moodle logs. Ordered by calendar time, models were updated only with available outcomes and remained unchanged for all predictions at each prediction cutoff; development, calibration and evaluation were chronologically separate. We compared stochastic gradient descent logistic regression (SGD-LR), online sequential extreme learning machine (OSELM) and echo state network (ESN) across predictive performance, fixed, frozen and rolling threshold policies, calendar-time variation and four behavioural feature sets. Held-out evaluation comprised 49,329 predictions with 37.68% inactivity-onset prevalence. Discrimination was similar (average precision 0.665-0.679; ROC-AUC 0.755-0.774). OSELM had the highest recall, SGD-LR the highest precision and specificity, and ESN the highest Matthews correlation coefficient and balanced accuracy. Lower thresholds increased recall and alert volume, whereas rolling adaptation did not improve MCC over frozen thresholds. Weekly performance and calibrated-probability distributions varied without sustained deterioration. During model selection, cumulative-and-temporal features achieved the highest individual-set AP, with modest gains from combining all feature groups. These findings indicate that streaming early-warning evaluation should consider calibration, threshold-dependent performance, alert burden and calendar-time variation alongside aggregate discrimination.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文基于 Moodle 日志构建时间同步的 prequential（预序）在线评估框架，用于提前一周预测学生的停止活动，并比较 SGD-LR、OSELM 与 ESN 在固定、冻结与滚动阈值策略及四类行为特征下的判别性能与告警负担。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「只使用当时可得信息、无前视」的时序评估设计，可能为 LVR 中逐步生成状态、动态计算与停止决策的评价方式提供线索，阈值—召回—告警负担的权衡可供核查；但该工作属教育数据挖掘，与视觉多模态推理无直接关联。
